title: 8 Hostinger AI Builder Alternatives for Full-Stack App Development in 2027
summary: Hostinger AI Builder offers an affordable entry point for creating websites and web applications, including projects with databases and authentication…
body_markdown:
Hostinger AI Builder offers an affordable entry point for creating websites and web applications, including projects with databases and authentication. Teams needing native mobile publishing or different infrastructure and export options may still want to explore alternatives. Hostinger advertises promotional pricing with multiyear commitments, a first-year domain offer, and higher renewal rates. Its AI Builder supports data-driven web applications but has limited AI-credit allowances and does not produce native iOS or Android apps for store publishing.


According to Grand View Research, the global low-code application development platform market was projected to reach[$43.4 billion in 2026](https://www.grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/low-code-application-development-platform-market) , highlighting growing demand for faster ways to build software. This 2027 guide examines eight alternatives through the lens of[full-stack app development](https://floot.com/blog/how-to-build-full-stack-app-with-ai) , helping non-technical founders, small business owners, and development teams evaluate platforms that match their application requirements.


## **Key Takeaways**


- **Build through familiar AI assistants** : Floot's[MCP connector](https://floot.com/blog/what-is-mcp-a-simple-guide-to-model-context-protocol-for-ai-apps) supports Claude, Codex, Cursor, and compatible ChatGPT configurations. Available actions depend on each client's connector permissions.
- **Managed infrastructure simplifies deployment** : With[managed infrastructure](https://floot.com/blog/ai-app-builders-backend-platforms) , Floot supplies PostgreSQL, authentication, hosting, and storage while the connected AI assistant handles development.
- **Free to start with distinct costs** : Floot's[pricing structure](https://floot.com/en/pricing) separates daily building actions from hosting allowances and credits for optional AI features.
- **Mobile publishing has separate requirements** : Floot supports[mobile app builds](https://floot.com/docs/mobile-apps/creating-mobile-apps-in-floot) for iOS and Android, but store submission requires developer accounts and approval.
- **Code ownership differs from downloads** : Floot users own their code and data on every plan; its[export documentation](https://floot.com/docs/faqs/code-data-and-exports) explains database downloads and paid project ZIP exports.


## **What to Look for in a Full-Stack AI App Builder**


Full-stack application development requires more than generating frontend interfaces. Features to evaluate when choosing a platform for production-ready applications include:


- **Database management** : Structured data storage with SQL access, table views, and export capabilities
- **User authentication** : Email/password login plus OAuth providers like Google and Microsoft
- **Backend logic** : Serverless endpoints for business rules, API integrations, and data processing
- **File storage** : Managed uploads for images, documents, and application assets
- **Hosting and deployment** : CDN-backed delivery with custom domain support
- **Mobile publishing** : Native app shells for App Store and Google Play distribution


Hostinger AI Builder supports business websites, ecommerce, and data-driven web apps, but its limited AI-credit allowance and lack of native mobile app publishing may be limiting for some projects. Renewal pricing can also increase significantly after a promotional period, changing the cost calculation. Prices below are in USD and reflect information checked on November 23, 2026; annual billing is identified where applicable.


## **1. Floot**


Floot is a full-stack app-building platform with an MCP connector that lets users create, edit, and publish applications through supported AI assistants, including Claude, Codex, Cursor, and compatible ChatGPT configurations. Floot provides managed infrastructure while the connected AI assistant handles development, with available building capabilities depending on the client's connector permissions. It complements these AI tools rather than replacing them.


### **Key Capabilities**


Floot supports non-technical founders, operators, and business owners building working applications with saved data and user accounts. Its[backend services](https://floot.com/blog/ai-app-builders-backend-platforms) help users publish apps without separately configuring databases and hosting.


- **MCP connector integration** : Create, edit, and publish through supported AI assistants, subject to the client's connector permissions
- **Managed PostgreSQL** :[Built-in database](https://floot.com/blog/ai-app-builders-built-in-databases) with SQL access, browser-based table view, and export on all plans
- **User authentication** : Email/password login plus[Google and Microsoft OAuth](https://floot.com/blog/ai-app-builders-built-in-user-authentication) brokering without separate OAuth app setup
- **File storage with CDN** : Managed storage for uploads and assets with CDN-backed delivery
- **Payments, email, and domains** :[Stripe payments](https://floot.com/docs/integrations/payments) ,[transactional email](https://floot.com/docs/integrations/email) , and custom domains; live payments and verified sending domains require a paid plan
- **Mobile app publishing** : Package web applications in native iOS and Android shells for[app store submission](https://floot.com/docs/mobile-apps/creating-mobile-apps-in-floot)
- **Serverless backend** : TypeScript endpoints for business logic without server management


### **Pricing Structure**


- **Free** : $0/month, 100 build actions/day, 2 mobile app builds/month, and a one-time $3 hosting credit; no recurring hosting allowance
- **Pro** :[$25/month](https://floot.com/en/pricing) with 1,000 daily actions, 5,000 monthly AI credits, $10/month hosting allowance, and 12 mobile builds/month
- **Power** : $100/month with 5,000 daily actions, 15,000 monthly AI credits, $25/month hosting allowance, and unlimited mobile builds


### **Considerations**


Floot's connector architecture lets builders work within existing AI environments. The connected assistant can inspect project files, update applications, provision database tables, and deploy changes when the client permits those connector operations. Connector-based building uses the user's existing eligible AI subscription, while Floot's optional in-app agent and application AI features use separate AI credits.


Floot includes core services for published applications: database, authentication, hosting, storage, payments, and email. Production use still requires appropriate testing and application-specific configuration. Database export is available on all plans, and paid plans support full project ZIP downloads. The authentication system brokers Google and Microsoft OAuth without requiring separate OAuth app registration.


Floot packages web applications in native iOS and Android shells for submission to the App Store and Google Play. Floot handles cloud builds and uploads to testing tracks, while app owners manage store review and approval. Free includes 2 mobile builds monthly, Pro includes 12, and Power offers unlimited builds. Connecting Google Play requires a paid Floot plan, and Apple and Google developer accounts are needed for store submission.


Floot separates building actions from AI credits and hosting usage. Failed actions do not count against action limits. Hosting usage beyond the included allowance draws on prepaid hosting credit, with optional auto-reload turned off by default. Users own their code, data, and intellectual property on every plan. Floot is backed by Y Combinator (S25 batch).


## **2. Lovable**


Lovable is an AI app builder that generates web applications with frontend and backend functionality. It supports rapid MVP development, built-in backend services through Lovable Cloud, and optional Supabase integration. For a comparison of assistant-based workflows and separate AI billing, see Floot's[Lovable alternatives guide](https://floot.com/blog/lovable-mcp-alternatives) .


### **Primary Focus**


- **UI generation** : Generates application interfaces from natural-language prompts
- **Backend services** : PostgreSQL database, authentication, and storage through Lovable Cloud or Supabase connection
- **GitHub synchronization** : Two-way code sync for version control and ownership
- **Credit-based building** : Prompts consume variable credits based on complexity


### **Pricing Structure**


Lovable uses a credit-based model where different operations consume different amounts. Its illustrative examples include 0.50 credits for changing a button's color and 1.20 credits for adding authentication, although actual use varies by task. The free tier provides 5 daily build credits, capped at 30 per month, plus 20 monthly Cloud credits. Pro costs $25/month with 100 monthly credits.


### **Considerations**


Lovable offers built-in backend services through Lovable Cloud, with Supabase available as an alternative integration. Its credit consumption model creates variable building costs, and cloud usage may involve additional charges.


## **3. Bolt.new**


Bolt.new is a developer-focused code generator that provides full access to generated source code with flexible framework choices and deployment options. Floot's[Bolt comparison](https://floot.com/blog/floot-vs-bolt-which-ai-app-builder-is-better-in-2026) discusses the different building workflows.


### **Primary Focus**


- **Full code control** : Complete access to generated source with npm package support
- **Framework flexibility** : Choose React, Vue, Next.js, or other frameworks
- **WebContainers technology** : Run Node.js environments directly in the browser
- **Deployment options** : Export to Netlify, Vercel, or Bolt Cloud


### **Pricing Structure**


Bolt.new uses a token-based model with a free tier limited to 300,000 tokens per day and 1 million tokens per month. Its Pro plan starts at $25/month with 10 million tokens monthly. Token consumption varies based on prompt complexity and iteration cycles.


### **Considerations**


Bolt.new combines developer control with Bolt Cloud, which provides managed databases, authentication, and hosting. External backend services remain optional for projects requiring different infrastructure.


## **4. Base44**


Base44 is an AI-generated full-stack platform that became part of Wix in June 2025. The platform targets business applications and internal tools with built-in database and authentication capabilities. Floot's[Base44 alternatives guide](https://floot.com/blog/base44-alternatives) covers additional options.


### **Primary Focus**


- **Full-stack generation** : Database, authentication, and application logic from prompts
- **Google OAuth** : Built-in Google authentication support
- **Two-way GitHub sync** : Version control integration available on Builder and higher plans
- **Internal tools focus** : Designed for business applications and dashboards


### **Pricing Structure**


- **Free** : 25 message credits/month, capped at 5 per day
- **Starter** : $16/month with 100 message credits, billed annually
- **Builder** : $40/month with 250 message credits, billed annually
- **Pro** : $80/month with 500 message credits, billed annually
- **Elite** : $160/month with 1,200 message credits, billed annually


### **Considerations**


Base44 became part of Wix in June 2025. Its pricing uses message and integration credits, which should be compared separately with build-action and token-based billing models.


## **5. Replit Agent**


Replit Agent is an AI coding assistant within Replit's cloud development environment, combining code generation with a full IDE workspace.


### **Primary Focus**


- **Full IDE environment** : Complete development workspace with collaboration features
- **Language flexibility** : Support for Python, Java, Rust, Go, C#, and other languages beyond JavaScript
- **Built-in database** : Managed PostgreSQL with separate development and production databases
- **Code-first approach** : Generated code with full developer access and modification


### **Pricing Structure**


- **Starter** : Free with limited Agent usage
- **Core** : $20/month with $20 in monthly credits and unlimited workspaces; published-app hosting is subject to usage billing
- **Pro** : $100/month with $100 in credits and more parallel tasks


### **Considerations**


Replit Agent supports conversational app building for non-technical users while providing an IDE for developers who want direct code control. Its extensive language support and advanced development tools make it suitable for a range of technical experience levels.


## **6. Bubble**


Bubble is a mature visual no-code platform that has been building its ecosystem since 2012, offering extensive plugins and templates for complex applications.


### **Primary Focus**


- **Visual workflow builder** : Drag-and-drop interface for application logic
- **Plugin ecosystem** : Over 1,000 plugins for extended functionality
- **Built-in database** : Proprietary visual database with no SQL required
- **Established platform** : 10+ years of development and community resources
- **Native mobile app building** : Build and publish iOS and Android apps, with options for bringing existing web applications to mobile


### **Pricing Structure**


- **Free** : Limited features and Bubble branding
- **Starter (Web)** : $32/month, billed annually
- **Growth (Web)** : $119/month, billed annually
- **Team (Web)** : $349/month, billed annually
- **Mobile and Web & Mobile** : Separate pricing tiers available


### **Considerations**


Bubble applications are locked to the platform with no code export option. The visual builder has a learning curve, and the proprietary database structure creates long-term platform dependency.


## **7. v0 by Vercel**


v0 by Vercel is an AI application builder focused on React and Next.js, supporting UI generation, full-stack application development, and Vercel deployment. Floot's[v0 alternatives guide](https://floot.com/blog/v0-alternatives) compares other approaches.


### **Primary Focus**


- **React/Next.js focus** : Component and application generation for the React ecosystem
- **Vercel deployment** : One-click deployment to Vercel's hosting infrastructure
- **UI component library** : Access to generated components for reuse
- **Code ownership** : Full access to generated source code


### **Pricing Structure**


- **Free** : $0/month with a 7-message daily limit
- **Plus** : $30/user/month with $30 in included monthly credits
- **Business** : $100/user/month
- **Enterprise** : Custom pricing


### **Considerations**


v0 supports full-stack Next.js development, including backend endpoints and database integrations. Persistent data, authentication, and additional services can be configured through supported providers and Vercel integrations.


## **8. ChatGPT Sites**


ChatGPT Sites lets eligible ChatGPT users create, preview, and publish interactive websites and lightweight applications through ChatGPT Work or Codex. It is designed for focused web experiences such as dashboards, project trackers, and internal tools.


### **Primary Focus**


- **Conversational website creation** : Build and refine sites through natural-language instructions in ChatGPT
- **Built-in data storage** : Store information in a site database and handle uploaded files
- **Connected apps** : Build experiences that use visitors' connected services and existing permissions
- **Web publishing** : Publish sites with configurable sharing and access controls


### **Pricing Structure**


ChatGPT Sites is available on eligible paid ChatGPT plans, including Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise. Building and editing count toward Codex usage. Hosting is currently included for Plus and Pro, subject to usage and storage limits, while workspace arrangements may differ for Business and Enterprise.


### **Considerations**


ChatGPT Sites suits lightweight web applications and shareable interactive experiences. Builders needing managed full-stack infrastructure, native mobile app packaging, or app-store submission should compare those requirements separately.


## **Why Floot Stands Out for Full-Stack App Development**


For builders evaluating Hostinger AI Builder alternatives, Floot combines an MCP connector with managed infrastructure for apps that need user accounts and persistent data. It works alongside supported AI assistants rather than replacing them, and available operations depend on each client's connector permissions.


- **Familiar tools** : Build and revise apps through supported assistants using Floot's[MCP workflow](https://floot.com/blog/what-is-mcp-a-simple-guide-to-model-context-protocol-for-ai-apps) .
- **Managed services** : Get PostgreSQL, authentication, storage, email, payments, and hosting through one[full-stack platform](https://floot.com/blog/ai-app-builders-web-apps) .
- **Distinct costs** : Use existing eligible AI subscriptions for connector-based development, with separate[plan allowances](https://floot.com/en/pricing) and hosting usage.
- **Mobile builds** : Package web apps for[iOS and Android](https://floot.com/blog/ai-app-builders-mobile-apps) without local Xcode setup; store approval remains required.
- **Ownership and export** : Keep ownership of code and data, with full project downloads on paid plans under Floot's[export options](https://floot.com/docs/faqs/code-data-and-exports) .


Floot is free to start. It is designed for non-technical founders, operators, and business owners who need a working application rather than a static prototype.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What makes Floot different from other Hostinger alternatives?**


Floot is a full-stack app-building platform with an[MCP connector](https://floot.com/blog/what-is-mcp-a-simple-guide-to-model-context-protocol-for-ai-apps) for Claude, Codex, Cursor, and compatible ChatGPT configurations. The connected AI assistant handles development within its permissions while Floot provides PostgreSQL, authentication, hosting, and storage. Its mobile-building workflow can also prepare iOS and Android apps for store submission.


### **Can full-stack applications be built with AI builders for free?**


Many platforms are free to start, with limits. Floot's[Free plan](https://floot.com/en/pricing) includes 100 daily building actions, 2 mobile app builds monthly, and a one-time $3 hosting credit. Lovable provides up to 5 daily build credits, capped at 30 per month, while Base44 provides 25 monthly message credits. Production applications may require paid capacity or additional hosting usage.


### **How do different pricing models compare for app development costs?**


Floot's[Pro plan](https://floot.com/en/pricing) costs $25/month and includes 1,000 daily building actions, 5,000 monthly AI credits, and $10 in monthly hosting allowance. Connector-based development uses the user's existing eligible AI subscription rather than a second Floot AI build-credit bill. The optional Floot agent, app AI features, hosting overages, and third-party services can add costs. Compare these separately with credit-based platforms.


### **What level of technical knowledge do AI app development platforms require?**


Technical requirements vary. Floot supports non-technical builders through[conversational development](https://floot.com/blog/ai-app-builders-web-apps) with permitted connector operations. Bubble offers visual building without code. Replit Agent and Bolt.new combine conversational building with more direct code access. Regardless of the tool, builders should test workflows and review permissions before launch.


### **Can code and data be downloaded when leaving an AI app building platform?**


Export policies differ. Floot guarantees code and data ownership on all plans, and its[export guide](https://floot.com/docs/faqs/code-data-and-exports) explains database exports and paid full-project ZIP downloads. Lovable and Base44 support GitHub synchronization on qualifying plans. Hostinger's one-way project code export has separate limitations for backend data, while Bubble does not provide source-code export. Moving any app may require additional deployment setup.
